description: A solitary figure looks through a window in a dimly lit, shadowy interior space. Yellow light pours through the window. The figure wears a white, flowing garment and has reddish-brown hair that runs down their back. On the bottom left corner of the composition is text that reads "G. O'Keeffe" printed backwards.
imageCaption: Image courtesy of a scanned transparency made for Georgia O'Keeffe: Catalogue Raisonné. This image has not been color proofed and may differ from the original. It will be replaced when newer photography becomes available.
title: Untitled (Woman By Window)
